_note: STARTING POINT — curated by ClauseWise maintainers. Fallback reference for documents that do not match a specific type. Not legal advice; used only for severity comparison within the tool.

typical_patterns.typical: Clear, specific, and mutual obligations. Each party knows exactly what they must do and by when.
red_flags: obligations can be changed unilaterally by one party

typical_patterns.typical: Payment amounts, schedule, and method clearly stated. Late payment consequences disclosed.
red_flags: payment can be changed without consent

typical_patterns.typical: Either party may terminate on reasonable notice. Obligations at termination clearly stated.
Liability limited proportionately. Gross negligence and fraud not excluded.
red_flags: all liability disclaimed including gross negligence
indemnity clause extremely broad and one-sided

typical_patterns.typical: Neutral forum, accessible to both parties. Both parties bear their own costs unless award made.
red_flags: jurisdiction clause in a location inaccessible to one party
